The '''Rift Disaster''' was an event wherein many ships of the [[Charr Ontee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Kathol]] were "flipped" between dimensions, from [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] into [[otherspace]]. The Charr Ontee stranded in otherspace found a [[Charon homeworld|new home]], and degenerated into a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] known as the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]].
